title: Call brief — account health (Midwest Retail)
body:
Quick context:
- Account: Midwest Retail (pilot -> scaling). Annual contract, current usage up 18% q/q but token spend spikey around promotions.
- Stakeholders: EVP Product (primary exec), Marcus Lee (AE), Ravi Singh (SE), Ops lead: Dana Morales.
- Renewal window: Oct 2026 (but sales cadence wants NRR check-in in May).

Meeting goal (30 min):
1) Surface any blockers preventing scale (infra, integration, cost).
2) Align AE/SE/CS on immediate asks to unblock next phase (production rollout to 3rd region).
3) Agree on 3 measurable actions before next sync.

Agenda (rough timing):
- 0–3m: quick rapport + wins (Marcus)
- 3–12m: usage & cost signals (me) — highlight spike dates and suspected causes
- 12–20m: SE deep dive (Ravi) — latency incidents, quantization tests, KV cache plan
- 20–27m: ask/commitments + risk review (all)
- 27–30m: confirm owners + next steps

Key data points to bring: (have screenshots/CSV ready)
- Weekly token consumption (last 8 weeks) — call out two promo spikes (Jan 12, Feb 6)
- Error rate / 95th p99 latency for generation routes (last 30 days)
- Cost-per-conversation estimate for promo vs baseline
- Current dedicated capacity mapping + average queue depth at 95th percentile

Hypotheses / talking bullets:
- Spikes correlate with promotional email sends — likely prefix-heavy prompts causing longer sequences and KV cache misses. Quick win: suggest prefix caching + small prompt trimming (>10% token reduction)
- SE notes: latency bump during peak is probably from multi-model fallback routing to CPU variant. Consider routing rule tweak to prefer quantized GPU variant for 95th percentile traffic.
- Business ask: AE pushing for region expansion (EU-West) — need SOW scoping (privacy review + infra).

Risks / escalations to surface:
- If spikes continue without prefix caching, unit cost could exceed committed threshold leading to inevitable pricing conversation at renewal.
- Security: customer requested HSM integration for keys — gating privacy review for private deployment.

Asks (what I need from AE/SE/CS):
- Marcus (AE): confirm upcoming promo schedule for May–June (dates) and primary user cohorts — send calendar invite + promo brief by EOD Wed.
- Ravi (SE): validate quick KV prefix-cache prototype on staging by next Tue; test with sample promo dataset. Also run short quantization perf run for their model variant.
- Me (Sofia): prepare cost scenarios (3x) — baseline, prefix-cache, routing-change; one-slide summary for execs.

Draft script bullets (open with):
- "Quick wins and reality checks — we saw great uplift in engagement during promos, want to make sure cost and latency scale with that success. Today’s focus: remove the obvious infra and prompt-level blockers so your pilots can expand to EU while keeping costs predictable."

Open questions to ask them live:
- Do you have a canonical 'promo prompt' set we can run through staging? (if yes, ask for samples in Slack)
- Any compliance/cardinal rules in EU expansion we should know before scoping infra? (data residency, PII handling)
- Are you comfortable with a canary route change for 24–48h to validate quantized GPU routing?

Prep checklist (for me):
- Attach CSV of token usage + spike annotations to the calendar invite — DONE (attached latest)
- Quick graph: baseline vs promo median sequence length — need to finish by Mon morning
- Add config diff for routing rule to Confluence page (link in artifacts) — draft ready

Desired outcomes & success metrics (for next sync):
- KV prefix-cache prototype validated and reduces average token length by >=8% on promo set.
- P99 latency during simulated promo load below 1.2x baseline after routing tweak.
- AE confirms EU expansion readiness checklist with primary legal/ops contact identified.

Follow-ups (post-call plan):
- Immediately post-call: send summarized notes + decisions in Slack channel + assign Jira tasks to Ravi/Me/Marcus (within 2h).
- 48–72h: deliver cost scenario slide to Marcus for exec review.
- 2 weeks: internal RT (retrospective) on promo handling run + kz (what worked / what to change).

Notes to self / friction points to watch:
- Keep the conversation technical enough to reassure SE but short — Marcus wants a clear one-line ask for execs.
- Avoid committing to dates for EU rollouts without legal sign-off.
- Customer tends to escalate to product quickly — flag potential product asks early.

Quick TODOs (my personal):
- [ ] Finish graph by Mon 09:00
- [ ] Draft the one-slide cost scenario by Mon 17:00
- [ ] Ping Marcus for promo calendar (if not received by Tue 10:00, escalate to AE manager)

Sticky notes:
- If prefix caching looks promising, propose a 2-week pilot on staging with a 1-week canary in us-west before rolling to EU.
- Keep the SOW ask separate from the immediate technical fixes; AE owns SOW kickoff conversation.

References/links to paste into call chat quickly:
- Confluence playbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/retail-midwest-playbook
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-987
- Internal notes: slack thread (acct-midwest-thread)

End of brief.

(Version notes: created as call-brief for 2026-03-12 sync; will update after call with owners + timestamps.)
